Reads a bounded private descriptor, then authenticates short-lived 127.0.0.1 HTTP requests with HMAC, nonce and descriptor identity checks for project-goal summaries or evidence. Reads and receipt/source POSTs are local IPC; enqueue POST persists a user-authorized pending draft, and a missing response after dispatch is reported as an unknown outcome. It does not invoke a provider.

The HTTPS Volcengine model broker caps request bytes, response bytes, time, answer tokens and per-task requests; disables thinking; sends only after TLS; records connection attempts and dispatch certainty; and treats incomplete usage or truncated output as unusable. Formal scope rejects creation, task start and direct dispatch. A separately running IPC/network broker is not contained by AsyncLocalStorage, and the diagnostic does not grant formal paid admission.
